verdict.rationale: Marqeta's JIT Funding gateway lets a developer's own system approve or decline funding/authorization requests in real time using custom business rules, which is the core of this story, but the evidence never documents the network's response-time budget or a configurable timeout/fallback behavior the developer controls. Webhooks (docs-9) are described only as async event notifications, not the real-time decisioning channel, so they don't fully substantiate the 'auth-stream endpoint' framing either. Missing for 10: documented timeout window/SLA for JIT funding responses, explicit fallback/default-decision configuration, and clarity on webhook vs. JIT funding as the real-time decision channel.
